source.note: Wave-1 row 43 named Quaternius Ultimate Fish via the poly.pizza CDN (behind a Cloudflare challenge). This is the OpenGameArt copy of a Quaternius clownfish: the Animated Fish pack (CC0; the same zip and sha256 pin as the koi, shark and dolphin), member FBX/Fish3.fbx, verified by rendering: an orange body with three white bands (head, mid-body, tail base) edged in dark rims. The bands are their own source material (Stripes) and the rims a third (Outline), so no colour is faked. Its only clip is Swim (a lateral body and tail wag; the Ultimate Fish clips Attack, Death, Swimming_Fast and Out_Of_Water are not in this pack). Coloured on the festival script: amber-orange body (#ffb020, shade #ff4d6d), warm white bands (#fff1ea, shade #ffd0a1), near-black rims (#1a1020, shade #24143a). Height 0.0515 m (dorsal fin to pelvic fins) gives a 0.10 m body, an adult ocellaris clownfish's length. A fish has no ground: like every entry its lowest rest point is at y = 0; films lift it into the water. The lateral stroke never dips below the rest floor, so no clip needs a lift or sinkAllowed.
